messages:
Jordan: Quick weekend poll — mini road trip to the coast (leave Sat morning) vs staying for the City Film Fest shorts block on Sunday. Who's in?
Priya: Road trip! 🚗 Need coffee and a good playlist. @Jordan can I carpool?
Mateo: Film fest for me, I have a free pass and need a chill Sunday.
Nina: Road trip sounds great, I can drive and bring a cooler.
Devon: I can do the road trip but need to be back Sunday evening.
Jordan: Plan idea — leave 8:00am Sat, breakfast stop at 101 Diner. Carpool from SF office lobby? @Priya?
Priya: Yep, I'll meet 7:40 outside the lobby.
Mateo: If it's the film fest, which venue are we thinking?
Nina: Roxie Cinema has a shorts block at 2pm on Sun — here's the schedule: https://roxie.example/schedule
Devon: Weather looks sunny for Sat ☀️, hardly any fog in the forecast.
Priya: Also can someone cat-sit for me? 😂 (kidding unless)
Jordan: lol @Priya maybe bring the cat-sitter app then :cat:
mini-bot: heads-up — Office bike racks closed Sat 7–11 for deliveries.
Nina: Tally so far: Road trip — Jordan, Nina, Priya, Devon (4). Film fest — Mateo (1).
Mateo: If you end up doing the drive back on Sun I might join for the ride home and sneak in the last shorts block.
Jordan: OK road trip it is. I'll make a quick Google doc for car assignments: https://docs.google.com/roadtrip
Priya: I'll bring the playlist + emergency snacks (trail mix + PB cups).
Devon: I'll bring a cooler + foldable chairs.
Nina: Bringing binoculars for some whale spotting 😄
Mateo: Take lots of pics please!
Jordan: Meeting point details:
```
SF Office Lobby
123 Redwood Ave
Meet 7:40am, depart 8:00am sharp
```
Jordan: Final check-in in #lunch-plans on Sat 7:30am :thumbsup:
Priya: Can't wait — see you all!
Nina: See y'all — I'll pack sunscreen and a uselessly large hat. :sun_with_face:
